notes.title: Exciting News: Market Tycoon Enters a New Chapter!
notes.content:
Dear Market Tycoon Community,

We hope this message finds you well and filled with excitement for the future of our beloved game Market Tycoon. Today, we are thrilled to share some major news that marks a new chapter in the journey of Market Tycoon.

We are delighted to announce that we have recently sold the rights of Market Tycoon to a passionate and capable gaming company that shares our vision for the game's growth and success. This decision was made with careful consideration, and we believe it is the best way to ensure the continued development and evolution of Market Tycoon.

This new company brings a wealth of experience and resources to the table, and we are confident that they will take Market Tycoon to new heights. Their dedication to quality and innovation aligns perfectly with the values we hold dear, and we believe this transition will ultimately benefit you, our fantastic community.

Rest assured, the essence of Market Tycoon will remain intact, and the new development team is committed to building upon the foundation we've created together. They are eager to listen to your feedback, incorporate your ideas, and work collaboratively to make Market Tycoon the best it can be.

We want to express our deepest gratitude for the incredible support you have shown us throughout this journey. And we are confident that the game is in capable hands moving forward.

Thank you for being an integral part of the Market Tycoon community. We look forward to witnessing the game's continued growth and success under its new guardians.

While bidding farewell to Market Tycoon is bittersweet, we're thrilled to invite you to embark on a new adventure with us. Join me in exploring the thrilling world of my latest creation, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2609880/Hackers_Life/]Hacker's Life![/url] This exciting journey wouldn't be complete without the incredible community that has made Market Tycoon so special. We hope you'll bring your enthusiasm, feedback, and creativity to this fresh endeavor, as we strive to create another immersive and captivating gaming experience together. Thank you for being an integral part of our community, and we can't wait to see where this new adventure takes us!

-Protection Games

notes.title: Market Tycoon Update V. 1.5.1
notes.content:
Hi Market Tycoon Fans,

This is the biggest content update to date for Market Tycoon. There are a lot of improvements and new features so let's get right into it.

First, continuing on what we started with the previous update [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/563360/view/2102558993189237507](Introducing Workshop for Market Tycoon)[/url] You can now add wall and floor paint to Steam Workshop for Market Tycoon. You can [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-MjKBnUF7C3Q7hW_1wBko6zUFaoo0583/view?usp=sharing]view the updated guide here[/url] for more information on how to use the tool.

Now let's get to the exciting stuff.
New market! Yes! There is a new bigger market with this update. The new market is twice as big as the older bigger market. And the good news is, another even bigger market is on the works for the next update so stay tuned.

Another heavily requested feature is decorations, and so here it is. With this version, there are 12 different pots and plants to decorate your market and 5 indoor fountains and one wall-mounted fountain for you to add to your markets. Not only that, but we also added two posters a wall mounted poster and a standing poster in which you can choose an item to promote for better sales (More poster designs coming in a future update)

On top of the new decorations, we also added 5 new fridges, 5 freezers, and one new rack. We are very excited to see how you will use all those new features and content to create spectacular looking markets. If you haven't done so already, [url=https://discord.gg/Pzf4A2g]join our discord server[/url] to share images of your market and stay up to date with the development of Market Tycoon.

As usual with any update, there are many small bug fixes and game balances and improvements. The graphic when placing an object has changed not to a grid visual that looks much better than previous updates and a new cool smoke effect when selling an object.

Please note that saved games prior to this version are not compatible with the new version.

That's it for now, update Market Tycoon now and enjoy the new features!

notes.title: NOW Introducing Workshop for Market Tycoon
notes.content:
Hello Market Tycoon Fans,

Finally, we bring to you Steam Workshop for Market Tycoon.

This might be considered as the biggest update to Market Tycoon yet.

First of all, we added one new gameplay feature and that is global auto restock. You can now select what items to auto restock from the quick Stats & price change page instead of having to select what items to auto restock per location.

As a small team, creating and adding items would take a lot of time from us that we would love otherwise to spend in adding more gameplay features. And since the game revolves around creating your own supermarket, offering more items is the meat of the game. Unfortunately, when developing Market Tycoon there were no plans to add any kind of support for any user-generated content. But since Market Tycoon has grown and became more popular than ever imagined and since the release of the game, we received many requests to support Steam Workshop to allow the community to add more items to Market Tycoon. And so, we decided to almost rewrite the core code of the game to allow user-generated content to work with Market Tycoon. So here we are today, with the introduction of Steam Workshop for Market Tycoon the possibilities are endless. At the time of this writing, we've had the workshop up for a week for a small group of people to test things out and there are already over 60 ready to use new items to chose from. And now with the Workshop going out to the public, we look forward to what you guys can bring to Market Tycoon.

And this is just the beginning. For now, you can only add items but we will be working to allow you to add more than that. Very soon you will have the option to create objects like shelves, fridges, freezers, and decorations as well as floor and wall paint and even a whole Market. More information on that when the time comes, so make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/Pzf4A2g]join our discord server[/url] for more updates.

If you are interested in creating Items for Market Tycoon, make sure to first read [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-MjKBnUF7C3Q7hW_1wBko6zUFaoo0583/view]Market Tycoon Item Tool Guide[/url]. We made it extremely easy to use the tool, all you need is a 3D model in .obj or .fbx format and any textures.

Make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/Pzf4A2g]join our discord server[/url] for faster support when using the tool and to keep up to date with the development of Market Tycoon.

Please note that markets created prior to version 1.5.0 are not compatible anymore. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.4.5
notes.content:
Hello Market Tycoon players,

We first want to apologize for taking too long to bring you this update, we underestimated how much work was needed to get the new item placing system ready for Steam Workshop. But enough excuses here is to a new time with faster more frequent updates.

As you know, we are working to support Steam Workshop on Market Tycoon. As said before we didn't plan for the game to be this big, and there were no plans to add workshop/mod support when we first started developing the game. For the past 5 months, many-core game code was changed to accommodate Steam Workshop. And in this update, you will start to see the results.

[b]So, what is new in this update?[/b]
Mainly, it's a new item placing system. On previous versions of Market Tycoon, every item had a preset list of where it can be put, how the items are configured in the shelf and a preset amount in each set. With this update information about the item and where you are trying to place it is fed to the new system and the game will automatically figure out if the item can physically be placed on the shelf and how to configure the item within the shelf. You will also be able to choose how many items to place using the arrow keys to add or subtract items. The system isn't perfect yet, there is still room for improvements and in a feature update you will have the option to chose how to configure the item from a normal style to a pyramid style or some other ways.

We believe this will drastically change how Market Tycoon is played by finding the best way to maximize profits and minimize expenses by choosing how much exactly of an item you want to be placed. 

We have also split the items into more categories and they are,

[list]
[*] Fruits & vegetables
[*] Snacks
[*] Breakfast & Cereals
[*] Bakery 
[*] Beverage
[*] Meat & Meals
[*] Grains & Pasta
[*] Soups
[*] Canned Food
[*] Condiments
[*] Dairy

[*] Household Essentials
[*] Pet Supplies [i](No items available in this category as of this update)[/i]
[*] Health and Beauty [i](No items available in this category as of this update)[/i]
[*] Clothing [i](No items available in this category as of this update)[/i]
[*] Electronics [i](No items available in this category as of this update)[/i]
[*] Auto [i](No items available in this category as of this update)[/i]

[*] Other
[/list]

[b]When is Steam Workshop coming?[/b]
In the next update. We have already begun working on it a few weeks ago. The tool is almost done it just needs a little more work and UI. Here is a sneak peek at the tool [spoiler][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28751995/03c800d621d038f6de5bc311be94844f60ea5f07.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28751995/ad29e71bb16eb994b4d39a58ecdde9cbed413460.jpg[/img][/url][/spoiler]
as you can clearly see the tool is still in work but the main controls are there. The final version of the tool will not like that at all.

[b]What will I be able to do with this tool?[/b]
With its first release, you will be able to add items to Market Tycoon and share it with the community. The tool will be very easy to use all you will have to do is upload a 3D model, verify/add textures, verify/modify size and rotation, and fill the information and you are done. You will then be able to share your item on Steam Workshop for other members of the community to download.
We are so excited so what items will be added.

In a feature update, you will be able to not only add items but objects like cashiers, shelves, fridges, freezer, and decorations you will also be able to add wall and floor paint as well.
As for adding market models, there are plans for that too but it might take longer due to the many variables associated with adding a market model. We would rather work on adding more gameplay features at this stage than developing a tool for adding markets. However, we will add more markets for you to play in a feature update. We will run a poll on our [url=https://discord.gg/xNu54uR]Discord channel[/url] to see what you guys want to see next.

Please note that markets saved prior to this update might not work as expected or might not load. New games made with this version will work just fine.

If you found any bugs please report them using the in-game bug reporter.

Thank you for your patience for this update. We will try our best to bring you Steam Workshop as soon as possible.

notes.title: Market Tycoon Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi Market Tycoon Fans,

Here with another update. We have some good news and some bad news.

We will start with the bad news as we like to keep the best for last. The bad news is we will delay the next update, but for a good reason that you'll like.

Here with the good news. As you know we are working on a tool to support Steam workshop which will allow you yo make content like items, objects, paint, etc.

We decided that to make this tool as useful as possible we have to make all items fit anywhere if it can physically fit within a shelf, not only items made with the tools but of course items that are already in-game. 

The way you place items on shelves now is using a preset number of items that may or may not fit in some shelves, fridges, or freezers some items have more or less as you can see from the items menu or using the arrow keys and you'll notice there is a maximum of 3 presets but most have only one.
We are working on a new system that will take each item and place it on a shelf one-by-one until it is full or as many as you want. For example, right now, if you want to place a set of apples you are forced to place 20 apples (unless you are restocking, but you will only able to restock on the place of the missing apples from those 20) the new system will allow you to place from 1 piece and up to the maximum number of apple that can physically fit in the given shelf. And that will apply to all items.

We are sorry again for the delay of this update but we hope you like what is coming and understand the reason for the delay, it will only bring you a better more polished product.

We are looking at a time frame from 2-4 weeks but we'll try our best to get it sooner.

Thanks for your continued support of Market Tycoon many exciting stuff is yet to come.

notes.title: Market Tycoon Dev Update
notes.content:
Hello Market Tycoon Fans,

Many asked when is the next update? Here to let you know our plans.

When we first started developing the game it was supposed to be much smaller than it is right now, as we didn't expect that much people will like it or be interested in the game. So thanks for everyone's continued support for the game.

And as you know the next big thing for Market Tycoon is workshop, and since we didn't plan for the game to be this big there were no plans to add workshop/mod support when we first started. After seeing the number of people that liked the game our goals changed for a bigger game with much more features than planned. As you can notice the last 2 updates last of which was a little over a week ago were all about bug fixes but what we didn't say is these updates also uses a new code that can accommodate workshop support.

Right now we are working on building tools for the community to use to make items, objects, paints, and eventually markets (We also want to add decorations and posters to the game which of course the community would be able to make more of). Initially, the tool will support making items and then the other stuff will be added to the tool as it gets ready. We are trying to make the tool as easy to use as possible and we are figuring out the best way to do so. Plans of how the tool will work are laid out and we'll start working on it in the upcoming days. We expect the tool will be ready for making items sometime next month but we can't guarantee exact timing yet, but be assured it's coming soon enough.

Thank you for your continued support for Market Tycoon.

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.4.4 (Bug Fixes & Future Update)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your patience for this update, we understand that this took too long.

Let's get into it, this update is kinda small in terms of gameplay but it improved on core game code setting it up for the support of Steam Workshop.

We focused on fixing bugs for this one but the main thing is that we rewrote the entirety of the code that handled the placement of items which took a lot of time. You might notice that most items can now be placed on shelves that weren't allowed to be placed there while it should have been. Previously items had a predefined list of shelves that can go into but now it calculates if it physically fit and of course whether an item is getting placed in a shelf, fridge, or freezer.

Many small bugs were fixed and improvements have been made. One big improvement is that when you train a cashier employee you had to click on the cashier and open it manually after training is done, that confused a lot of players on thinking that the employee just never comes back. Now, with this update, the employee automatically returns once training is done.



For the next update, we are planning on developing the tool for Steam Workshop that will initially let the community make items and later all sort of stuff like cashiers, shelves, fridges, freezers, [spoiler]decorations[/spoiler],  paint, and even the market itself.

Also, we want to optimize the game more especially with the UI so let us know what you want us to focus on more in our Discord server which you can  join from here: https://discord.gg/Pzf4A2g


Thank you again for your patience for this update we have a lot of exciting ideas which will make this game much more fun.

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.4.3 (Huge Optimization Update and Future Plans)
notes.content:
Hello there,

As we promised in giving you an update that will focus on optimizing the game, here it is.

We have received a number of complaints about lag and performance issues, and we are happy to let you know that with this update this issue is from the past. We were able to boost the performance from 15fps in some cases to 60fps.

And as you know with the last update, your old markets disappeared from the loading screen and as we explained that this was due to changes in core game code. We are happy to let you know that we were able to work around that and make most of your old markets loadable again. And with the new optimization, you can now enjoy your market with no lag.


As for the future, we would really love to bring workshop support for Market Tycoon and we are so excited to see what the community can bring to Market Tycoon. We also have plans for more features like janitors, security guards, thieves, disasters like rat infestation, online website for your market. Things like that will make the game more interesting and fun.

Thanks for your support and for everyone that sent in a bug report and helping us make Market Tycoon a better game.

Enjoy,

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.4.2 (Bug Fixes and Road-map)
notes.content:
Hey Market Tycoon Fans,

As many of you might have heard, we are working on bringing workshop support to Market Tycoon. Unfortunately, when we started developing Market Tycoon we did not plan to have workshop ready to be supported in the future. Therefore, we need to change many core game code to make it compatible with Workshop and that is taking some time. notes.title: Market Tycoon 1.3.0 Update (Biggest Update So Far)
notes.content:
Finally, after many delays Market Tycoon 1.3.0 is here.

First, we want to apologize for the many delays of this update, we wanted to give you the best we can and couldn't just rush things and give a flawed product. We hope that you'd understand.


So let's get into it, [b]what's new?[/b]

Setting aside all the background improvements, bug fixes, and optimization let's tell you about the new features.

[b]• Employee Uniform[/b]
This feature has been asked from the beginning, and it finally made it. We remember when many of you asked for this feature, but it didn't make much sense at the time, you only had one employee option which was cashiers. There are more than cashiers now (more on that later). For this feature, you will be able to choose the style of the uniform, as well as any color you can imagine with HSV sliders which will give you a wide range of colors to choose from and easily find the color you want.

[b]• Cargo Vans and Storage[/b]
Did this catch your attention? This is loads of fun and opens an interesting potential feature for later updates like [i]launching a website for your market and selling items through the internet (Planned feature)[/i]. So what is this? After placing your item, the item will not instantly get on the shelf (More on that next). You'll have to buy a cargo van ·send it to go and get your ordered items to your storage. And your items will remain in your storage until it expires or...... (see next)

[b]• Stocking Employee[/b]
Yes, stocking employee, the game now is much more fun and realistic. So how this will work? Well, you will no longer be able to instantly place items into shelves. You'll have to hire stocking employees that will stock your items from the storage. So basically, you will place items just like you did before but the item will be semi-transparent indicating that the item isn't' there yet. Once you have your item placed stocking employees will stock your items from the storage to the shelves. Now you will have to think and manage the quantity of an item you want to have. you don't want to have too much and risk losing it when it expires, and you don't want to have too little and lose potential profit you would have made while ordering ·more items and stocking it.

[b]• New Markets[/b]
This is the most noticeable thing on this update. With the introduction of the storage area which the old market didn't have, we had to make new markets. On this update, we have two markets. So, and for the lack of the storage area which is necessary to support the new ·features, the old markets have been removed. Therefore, you will no longer be able to load any saved games before this update.

[b]• Other Small New Features (Graphics, Camera Movement)[/b]
With the introduction of the new markets, we have drastically updated the graphics and the look of the game. And ·to give more views of your market, now you can pan the camera up and down by moving the mouse up or down when rotating the camera. We hope that you'll like how the game looks now as much as we did.

And that pretty much summarize the new features for this update, and as we said earlier there are many improvements on how things work in the background as well as loads of bugs that have been fixed many of them thanks to the bug reports we received from you over the past couple of months.



[b]What's next?[/b]
One of the features we wanted to include in this update was a brand new UI. Unfortunately, we wouldn't have been able to make it on time.

So, here is the plan for the next couple of updates*

[strike][b]• Market Tycoon 1.3.1[/b]	[/strike]
Brand new UI. The whole UI of the game will be recreated to look prettier and more user-friendly.

[strike][b]• Market Tycoon 1.3.2[/b]	[/strike]
Steam Achievements, trading cards, and macOS support

[strike][b]• Market Tycoon 1.3.3[/b]	[/strike]
More content. Anything from items, shelves, fridges, freezers, etc...

[strike][b]• Market Tycoon 1.3.4[/b]	[/strike]
More features.



[b]Now we need a small favor from you.[/b] Due to the new markets and the updated graphics we need new screenshots for Market Tycoon for both our website and the steam store page. To help us have great screenshots for the game and have a chance for your market to be featured as a screenshot on our website and the steam store page, make sure you have an internet connection and hold [b]Ctrl + U[/b] to send us screenshots. Please give it a few seconds for the screenshots to be sent (time will depend on your internet speed).

If you have a good understanding in English and would like to contribute to translating Market Tycoon to other languages please contact us through ·email contact@protectiongames.com
Please don't hesitate to contact us even if Market Tycoon is already translated into your language. The more translators we have the faster and better quality of translation can be achieved for the speakers of your language.


Please note that due to the many new features added in this update, translation to your language might not be up to date yet. The translation should automatically update once it's available.


Thank you for your continued support for Market Tycoon. Have fun!


*Subject to change

[h1]Restock One Shelf & Auto-Restock[/h1]

[b]The first feature is the two new buttons next to each shelf. These two buttons are for restocking, one which will restock only the item on the shelf instead of restocking the whole shelf, and the other one (the green one) is for auto-restocking.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/7d2737bd609fbc430aed3eda71bb1de1d2bf1c51.jpg[/img]

[b]The big new feature here is of course the auto-restocking feature. You can make it that is will auto restock when the shelf is empty, 1/4 is remaining, 1/3 is remaining, 1/2 is remaining, or 3/4 is remaining. In the future, this feature will require an employee that will be restocking your items, but for now, it will happen automatically.[/b]



[h1]Cashier Open/Close[/h1]

[b]This is an exciting feature, it is the way cashiers come and go, what does that mean?
Here is a gif:[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/cc900f5056ad0559e7830827d9e0c06860810ada.gif[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/25ac69e2a9fd25c806eb714b2a1a810440b64602.gif[/img]

[b]As you can see, instead of the cashiers magically appearing and disappearing when closing, opening, hiring, or selling the cashier registrar they will actually go and walk. Note that by selling the cashier registrar, the cashier employee will not be fired, but will be sent home.[/b]



[h1]Manage Employees[/h1]

[b]Next feature is employee experience. All employees will have experience points which will affect customer ratings. 

Then we come to the biggest feature of them all, a highly asked for feature, employee management. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/a04ef0d5dd0c223981bd443e6070c1aca310fcfd.jpg[/img]

This will be a new page that will list al;l your employees. You will be able to increase or decrease their salaries, you will also be able to train your employees to be faster or gain more experience.
You will notice that every employee has satisfaction points. These points reflect how satisfied the employee with the salary you are giving. When you train your employee they will get less satisfied as they expect you to give them a raise for them getting better. And be aware, if your employees are not satisfied, they might quit the job, so try to balance between the salary and satisfaction. And there are many small bug fixes and small features, like customers will analyze and chose which cashier to go to (the least crowded or the closest) small features like that you will have to look to find.

As for German translation, the translation is 90% complete, and an update with the German translation will be released as soon as the translation is finished. So, German translation confirmed/guaranteed.


We asked you to send us images of your market by holding Ctrl and pressing U, but we did not receive enough images. So, if you want your market to be featured as an image in a loading screen hold Ctrl and hit U the game will freeze for a few seconds or depending on your internet speed as a screenshot of your market is being uploaded and sent to us. If we liked your market, you might see it on a loading screen in a future update.

[b]And please if you liked the game, give us a positive review it will really help us make Market Tycoon a better game.[/b]

And that's it for this update,
Enjoy!

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.2.0 (Biggest Update Yet. New Languages, New Features and Bug Fixes)
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it's been a while since the last update and we hope this update will worth the waiting.

As you can see from the title, this is the biggest update Market Tycoon has every received and there is a lot of new features and bug fixes, so let's go into it.


First, what has been fixed:

• Fixed restock all showing the wrong price. (When hovering over the restock button it tells you how much restocking the shelf will cost, the value here was totally wrong and now has been fixed)

• Fixed item getting rotated in the wrong direction. (Sometimes when moving a shelf with items in it and rotating the shelf, the item stay in the same direction before rotating the shelf, this has been fixed with this version) It's worth mentioning that if you experienced this bug before, the affected items might not be fixed but this bug will not happen again.

• Fixed a bug where item popularity doesn't get loaded.

• Fixed a bug where the "?" sign not going away next to popularity when when "+" or "-" is added.

• Fixed item sales amount not getting saved on Quick Qtats and [spoiler] Price Change[/spoiler] page

• Fixed a bug where people get stuck next to the door or cashier.


Next, Improvements:

• A small improvement in AI pathfinding.

• Optimized game performance especially when placing items.

• Small Graphics/Color changes. Here are the before and after images.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/e083acb7b15e1ae97416414ea44ddec4517a81e7.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/9dfe6a9977e25c5de6bbd91ee8e461f35e16d07c.jpg[/img]

And there are many many more smaller bug fixes and improvements.


Now, the fun part. What's new:

• Many asked for this feature, Price Change. Yes, now you can increase or decrease prices. (Changed "Quick Stats & Discount" to "Quick Stats and Price Change")

• Another asked feature is item sort and item search, now you can search for items instead of finding it and/or sort by:
1- Alphabetically
2- Price Low-High
3- Price High-Low
4- Sales High-Low
5- SalesHigh-Low
6- Popularity

• Exit tabs and pages by clicking ESC.

• 64 brand new item. discover them.

• Customer comment. Now, customers will give comments about your market, so you could know what is working well or why your market rating is bad. Here is an example image:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/9b1008b51fefdd99db34b5c7fd24dd53758078e6.jpg[/img]

• Another really cool feature is Expiry Report. What is this feature you might ask? Now you can know exactly how many items are going to expire on a certain day. Here is an image:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/d877652a95d98de9df8995d3132e215848bc28cc.jpg[/img]

• And for people in Arab world, France and Romania, we are happy to tell you that Market Tycoon supports Arabic, French and Romanian languages. Russian Language is coming in the next update. 
If you have a good understanding in English and would like to help translate Market Tycoon to your language contact us by sending an email to contact@protectiongames.com


Now we need a favour from you. We are planning on having a loading screen with market images, to do that, while in-game hold Ctrl and hit U the game will freeze for a few seconds or depending on your internet speed as a screenshot of your market is being uploaded and sent to us. If we liked your market, you might see it on a loading screen in a future update.


There are much more planned features to come in the future as we sail along in the development of Market Tycoon.

That's it for now and thank you for waiting for this update.

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.0.14
notes.content:
In this update, more bug fixes. And these include but not limited to

•Fixed Financial Report not saving. (If you experienced this issue, we are very sorry to tell you that the financial report on that save game will not work as there was a bug on the data being saved, but this should not happen if you didn't experience this bug or created a new game after this update)

•Now, it's more clear as to why an item can't be placed in a particular rack, fridge, or freezer.

•Some minor bug fixes and improvements.



As for the characters getting stuck bug, we will be changing the whole AI system, this will make sure that the bug is fixed as well as provide a better and smoother AI, but changing the AI system could take some time, we hope we could finish it in less than a week. 

For the moment, a workaround is to either sell the rack, fridge, or freezer that the characters are getting stuck next to or moving the rack, fridge, or freezer and placing it back again. Alternatively, you can also just move any rack, fridge, or freezer across the stuck characters to let the system recalculate its path.
